title: IndexedDB Transaction Auto-Commit Lifecycle
description: See why awaiting a non-IDB Promise kills an active IndexedDB transaction.

steps.label: 1. Open readwrite Transaction
steps.description: db.transaction('docs', 'readwrite') acquires a write lock on the 'docs' object store and marks the transaction active.

steps.label: 2. Await External Promise (Trap)
steps.description: Calling await fetch(...) suspends the JS frame with zero pending IDBRequests. The engine auto-commits the transaction on microtask drain.
steps.codeHighlight: await fetch('/api/meta'); // No IDB requests queued!

steps.label: 3. Resume & Throw TransactionInactiveError
steps.description: When fetch resolves, calling store.put() throws TransactionInactiveError because the transaction already closed.
